lastCompletedStory.title: Add the zero-match-vacuous OracleLintRule and assert the cumulative main-vs-branch deltas

nextStoryContext: ZERO_MATCH_VACUOUS_RULE is now the fourth entry in RULES (src/supervisor/prd-oracle-lint.ts), name 'zero-match-vacuous', enforcing patterns.md:901. It covers two independent shapes via two helper detectors: (1) hasUnguardedSedLineAnchor -- SED_LINE_ANCHOR_RE matches `sed -n "${VAR}p"` and captures VAR; flagged unless a `test -n "$VAR"` / `[ -n "$VAR" ]` guard for that EXACT variable name appears anywhere in the command (guard is name-scoped via a dynamically built RegExp, not a bare -n sniff, so a guard on a different variable does not suppress the finding); (2) hasUnguardedGrepFedWhileRead -- GREP_FED_WHILE_READ_RE matches `grep -n ... | while read ...`, flagged unless GREP_COUNT_GUARD_RE (`grep -c ... -ge N`, N>=1) appears anywhere in the command. Both detectors are independent regex/string checks, no shell parsing, same OracleLintRule signature and no-I/O purity as the other three rules. RULES array order is now [GREP_Q_LIST_FILES_RULE, FROZEN_COMPARAND_RULE, ROTATING_ARTIFACT_RULE, ZERO_MATCH_VACUOUS_RULE] -- any future rule addition must append at the end and update the now-length-4 'RULES: named-rules list shape' assertion in the test file, plus the cumulative AC4/AC5 oracles in this story's own acceptanceCriteria (which count '_RULE' occurrences and describe-block names live via git diff against main, so they self-extend as long as future additions keep incrementing both by 1 per new rule). Two new dedicated describe blocks were added with load-bearing exact names ('zero-match-vacuous rule: flagged forms' / 'zero-match-vacuous rule: passing cases') consumed verbatim by this story's own `bun test -t` oracles; keep that naming convention for any future rule's dedicated test blocks -- this story's own AC5 depends on the cumulative count of 'flagged forms'/'passing cases' describe blocks added across US-001/US-002/US-003 all following this exact naming pattern, so a renamed earlier block would break this story's oracle even though this story didn't touch it. Full check:all spine (typecheck/test/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps) is green, 5229 tests pass (up from 5218 pre-story, +11 dedicated new tests plus the RULES-shape assertion delta).
